title: syn-policy
description: What one syn policy file states — `.syn/warn.toml` or `.syn/deny.toml` in the policy directory: one jq expression, evaluated against each issue of a sanity report. In warn.toml the issues it is true for are the ones syn shows; in deny.toml they are the ones a gate denies. A file that is absent leaves syn's built-in default for it in force; a file that is present states its filter and nothing else.

filter.description: A jq expression over one issue, true for the issues the policy selects.
